acutechgroupinc-acutechgroupinc:greenhou.title: Maritime Safety & Regulatory Consultant
acutechgroupinc-acutechgroupinc:greenhou.description: Who We Are: AcuTech Group, Inc. is a premier provider of process safety, risk management, chemical security, industrial fire protection engineering, and emergency management services. We have deep expertise in Process Safety Management (PSM), Training, Implementation, Auditing, Process Hazard Analyses (PHA’s), Hazard and Operability Studies (HAZOPs), Quantitative Risk Assessment (QRA) and Facility Siting, among other engineering and consulting services. AcuTech has deep specialization in the oil and gas, chemical, LNG, petrochemical, renewables, hydrogen, and other industries handling hazardous materials. Our industry experts deliver these services to leading privately held and publicly traded companies, as well as government agencies, and state sponsored entities globally. About The Job AcuTech Consulting Group is seeking a Maritime Safety & Regulatory Consultan t to support maritime safety, security, emergency management, and regulatory compliance projects associated with LNG facilities, marine terminals, port infrastructure, and energy transportation systems. This role will support a variety of consulting projects involving the U.S. Coast Guard (USCG), FERC, PHMSA, terminal operators, engineering firms, and other maritime stakeholders. The ideal candidate will possess strong technical writing, analytical, and project coordination skills, along with an interest in complex maritime and energy infrastructure projects. This position is well-suited for candidates with experience in maritime operations, emergency management, LNG or terminal operations, regulatory compliance, marine transportation, or operational risk analysis. What You’ll Do: Maritime Safety & Regulatory Support Support development of Waterway Suitability Assessments (WSAs) under 33 CFR Part 127. Participate in maritime risk assessments, navigation safety evaluations, and SIMOPS evaluations associated with LNG, crude oil, and marine cargo operations. Conduct research and analysis related to USCG, FERC, PHMSA, TSA, and international maritime regulatory requirements. Assist in development of Facility Security Plans (FSPs), Facility Security Assessments (FSAs), Emergency Response Plans (ERPs), and related regulatory documentation. Prepare technical reports, presentations, regulatory summaries, and client deliverables. Support emergency planning, operational risk evaluations, and consequence analysis activities. Project Coordination & Client Support Coordinate with clients, engineering teams, pilots, emergency responders, terminal operators, and regulatory agencies. Support stakeholder meetings, workshops, and project coordination activities. Track project schedules, deliverables, action items, and regulatory commitments. Assist with development of briefing materials, meeting summaries, and executive-level communications. Data Analysis & Technical Support Support GIS-based and quantitative risk analysis activities. Conduct research related to vessel traffic, marine operations, weather, tides, currents, and navigational constraints. Collect, organize, and analyze technical data associated with maritime transportation and infrastructure projects. Assist with development of hazard registers, risk matrices, and operational analyses. Business Development Support Support proposal preparation, technical scopes of work, and client presentations. Assist with development of marketing materials and professional content related to maritime safety, security, and regulatory compliance. Participate in strategic growth initiatives supporting maritime, energy, and critical infrastructure clients. What’s Required: Bachelor’s degree in Maritime Studies, Emergency Management, Engineering, Environmental Science, Homeland Security, Transportation, Criminal Justice, or related field preferred Minimum 3+ years of relevant experience in maritime operations, LNG or energy infrastructure, emergency management, regulatory compliance, marine transportation, operational risk analysis, or consulti

ghj-ghj:lever:4a7edf73-f5c9-478e-b73a-28.description: GHJ Search & Staffing is working with a well-established and growing organization in the healthcare industry who is seeking an experienced Accounts Payable Supervisor to lead its Accounts Payable team. This is an excellent opportunity for a hands-on AP professional with supervisory experience who enjoys improving processes, developing staff, and ensuring timely, accurate payment operations. Supervise and mentor a team of up to five Accounts Payable professionals. Oversee day-to-day Accounts Payable operations, ensuring accuracy, efficiency, and compliance. Monitor wire payment processing and payment disbursements. Review invoices, resolve discrepancies, and ensure timely vendor payments. Manage vendor aging reports and support monthly payment planning. Ensure timely and accurate month-end close activities related to Accounts Payable. Serve as the subject matter expert for AP policies, procedures, and internal controls. Analyze workflows and identify opportunities to improve efficiencies and streamline processes. Support fiscal year-end audits by providing requested documentation and information. Prepare ad hoc reports and analyses for management. Partner with internal departments to resolve payment issues and improve processes. Provide leadership, coaching, and ongoing development to the Accounts Payable team. Minimum of 4-5 years of full-cycle Accounts Payable experience. At least 1-2 years of supervisory or team lead experience. Strong knowledge of Accounts Payable processes, month-end close, accruals, and vendor payment procedures. Advanced Microsoft Excel skills. Experience working within an ERP system (Microsoft Dynamics GP or similar preferred). Excellent organizational, analytical, and problem-solving skills. Strong communication skills with the ability to collaborate across departments. Demonstrated ability to lead a team while maintaining a high level of accuracy and accountability. Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Business, or related field is preferred but equivalent experience will also be considered. Stable and growing organization with long-term career opportunities. Leadership role with direct impact on departmental operations. Collaborative and team-oriented environment. Opportunity to improve processes and drive operational efficiencies. Competitive salary + comprehensive benefits Hybrid work schedule after successful onboarding and training. #GHJSS #LI-MO1

jobgether-jobgether:lever:0d8dc6d1-1359-.title: Principal Product Designer
jobgether-jobgether:lever:0d8dc6d1-1359-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Principal Product Designer based in United States. This is a highly strategic design leadership role focused on shaping the future of AI-powered prospecting experiences. You’ll connect outbound prospecting, AI-driven lead qualification, and demand generation into a cohesive end-to-end experience. Working across product, engineering, and design teams, you’ll influence product strategy and establish a clear vision for a complex ecosystem. You’ll design systems rather than isolated screens, simplifying sophisticated workflows while preserving the needs of different users. The role offers significant autonomy and the opportunity to define emerging interaction patterns for agent-based and AI-powered experiences. You’ll also guide senior designers, build alignment across teams, and influence stakeholders at the highest levels of the organization. As the prospecting space evolves, you’ll have the freedom to identify new opportunities where your expertise can create the greatest impact. Define and champion a forward-looking product design vision for end-to-end prospecting, connecting outbound, inbound AI qualification, and demand-generation experiences across multiple products. Design cohesive systems and workflows across complex product ecosystems, balancing simplicity and usability with the underlying technical and business complexity. Shape product strategy by partnering closely with product, engineering, and design leaders, challenging assumptions and introducing new approaches to how go-to-market teams operate. Lead through influence across multiple teams and disciplines, building alignment among stakeholders with different objectives, priorities, and perspectives. Guide and collaborate with senior and staff-level designers, helping establish shared design direction and raising the quality of cross-product experiences. Explore interaction models and design patterns for AI-powered and agent-based workflows, helping define how users interact with AI, tools, and systems of record. Consider practical constraints including usage and cost predictability, data quality and availability, privacy, legal requirements, automation, and user control. Maintain a strong customer focus while translating complex business and technical challenges into intuitive, scalable product experiences. Identify new areas of opportunity once the core prospecting problem space is addressed, proactively directing design energy toward the highest-impact challenges. Requirements Extensive experience as a product designer, typically with 12+ years of experience , or an equivalent level of expertise demonstrated through a different career path. Strong systems-thinking skills, with experience designing across multiple products, complex workflows, platforms, or established ecosystems with significant scale and surface area. Demonstrated ability to connect fragmented experiences into cohesive end-to-end journeys and translate complex systems into intuitive user experiences. Advanced interaction design expertise, with an understanding of how different user types, such as administrators and end users, have distinct needs and behaviors. Proven experience influencing product direction and communicating a compelling design vision to senior stakeholders, including VP-level audiences. Strong storytelling, presentation, and communication skills, combined with the confidence to advocate for a clear point of view and bring others along. Experience leading cross-functional initiatives, navigating ambiguity, and building alignment without relying on direct authority. Experience mentoring or guiding senior designers and contributing to a high-performing, collaborative design culture. Demonstrated interest in AI-powered or agent-based experiences, with the ability to think critically about how AI changes user expectations, behaviors, and interaction model

jobgether-jobgether:lever:46c10062-0a3a-.title: Senior Director, Global Medical Capability Excellence Lead
jobgether-jobgether:lever:46c10062-0a3a-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Director, Global Medical Capability Excellence Lead based in United States. This senior leadership role will shape how global medical capabilities are deployed, embedded, and continuously improved across a complex, international organization. You will translate capability strategy into practical execution, ensuring teams have the governance, processes, and tools needed to operate effectively. The role partners closely with global, regional, business-unit, and affiliate stakeholders to drive alignment and measurable impact. You will lead governance forums, prioritize improvement opportunities, and establish clear performance measures against strategic roadmaps. The position also plays a key role in integrating newly acquired ventures and managing organizational change across medical functions. Success requires strategic thinking, strong influence, and the ability to turn complex stakeholder input into decisive action. This is an opportunity to shape operating excellence in medical affairs while ultimately helping accelerate better outcomes for healthcare professionals and patients. Strategy, governance, and continuous improvement: Define and evolve the global medical capability strategy and multi-year roadmap; establish frameworks to assess implementation progress and impact; align priorities across global, regional, business-unit, and affiliate stakeholders; and lead governance forums that support prioritization, decision-making, and performance tracking. Capability deployment: Coordinate the global rollout of medical capabilities through capability-lead forums and communities of practice; oversee capability deep-dives, self-assessments, follow-up actions, and deployment initiatives; prioritize opportunities based on impact, feasibility, and strategic relevance; and promote best-practice sharing and learning. Operational and process excellence: Help teams establish and optimize core processes, identify cross-functional gaps and pain points, and coordinate initiatives that improve operating models and end-to-end capability delivery across multiple teams and geographies. New venture integration: Assess medical activities associated with newly acquired ventures, ensure requirements are incorporated according to development stage, and evaluate the organizational capacity needed to support integration and ongoing execution. Change management: Partner with capability leaders and relevant internal teams to assess the organizational impact of changes to medical capabilities and processes, then develop and execute stakeholder engagement and communication plans that support effective adoption. Executive stakeholder engagement: Communicate progress, insights, risks, strategic priorities, and recommended trade-offs to senior stakeholders, translating complex information into clear actions and decisions. Performance and impact management: Maintain visibility into capability performance and roadmap progress, identify areas requiring intervention, and ensure capability deployment and process improvements deliver measurable and sustainable impact. Cross-functional leadership: Lead complex initiatives where you may not be the subject-matter expert, build alignment across diverse stakeholder groups, challenge the status quo constructively, and drive strategy through to execution. Requirements Education and experience: Bachelor’s degree and at least 8 years of experience in the pharmaceutical industry; an MBA is preferred. Medical affairs expertise: Experience working within medical affairs and with affiliates or geographically distributed organizations is highly valued. Strategic leadership: Demonstrated ability to shape strategic thinking, manage complex and ambiguous challenges, establish priorities, and convert strategic direction into practical execution. jobgether-jobgether:lever:69cb837e-2359-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Data Analyst based in Germany. As a Data Analyst, you’ll transform complex market data into actionable insights that support important commercial and product decisions. You’ll focus on pricing trends and market movements across materials used in semiconductor device manufacturing. The role combines hands-on analysis with data quality management, documentation, and continuous improvement of analytical processes. You’ll work with data from multiple sources, applying rigorous standards to extract, validate, clean, and synthesize information. Your findings will contribute to a high-value market intelligence product and help ensure the reliability of data used by customers and internal teams. You’ll join a fast-paced, cross-functional environment where curiosity, resourcefulness, and the ability to learn new tools are highly valued. The position is fully remote and offers an opportunity to develop your analytical expertise within a specialized technology and market intelligence environment.

jobgether-jobgether:lever:ea148b20-d256-.title: Senior QA Automation Engineer
jobgether-jobgether:lever:ea148b20-d256-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior QA Automation Engineer based in Denmark. This is a senior-level quality engineering role focused on protecting the reliability, correctness, and scalability of critical payment flows. You’ll combine exploratory testing with an automation-first approach across APIs, distributed services, and external financial integrations. The role offers ownership of end-to-end quality, from test strategy and automation through production debugging and release readiness. You’ll work closely with backend engineers and product teams to define acceptance criteria, improve testability, and strengthen quality gates. The environment is modern and cloud-based, with Java, Spring Boot, REST APIs, React, PHP, AWS, and Playwright at its core. You’ll have the opportunity to influence engineering standards while working on a high-impact fintech platform used for global payments and financial operations. This is an ideal opportunity for a technically strong QA professional who enjoys solving complex problems and building scalable, reliable testing practices. Own end-to-end quality for critical payment journeys, including deposits, payouts, reconciliation, and other business-critical transaction scenarios. Design and execute API-first test strategies covering REST, JSON, HTTP, and complex transaction lifecycles. Build, maintain, and improve automated API and selective UI test suites using Playwright, RestAssured, or comparable frameworks. Develop reusable automation components such as API clients, test data builders, and supporting utilities. Test integrations with external providers, including payment processors and Open Banking services, with particular attention to asynchronous callbacks, polling, retries, and failure scenarios. Investigate production incidents, reproduce defects, analyze logs, database records, and API traces, and contribute to root-cause analysis. Collaborate with backend engineers to improve system testability and work with product teams to establish clear acceptance criteria. Contribute to release quality gates, regression testing strategies, smoke tests, and pre-release validation within CI/CD pipelines. Identify risks across distributed payment systems and proactively strengthen testing coverage, reliability, and engineering quality standards. Explore AI-assisted QA and automation techniques where they can improve testing efficiency and effectiveness. Requirements Proven experience in QA engineering, test automation, or a closely related software quality role, with strong ownership of complex systems. Hands-on experience testing REST APIs, including HTTP, JSON, request/response validation, and API-driven workflows. Strong understanding of backend systems, distributed services, and software integration patterns. Practical experience with test automation frameworks such as Playwright, RestAssured, or similar tools. Ability to diagnose technical issues using application logs, databases, API traces, and other debugging tools. Understanding of asynchronous systems and transaction patterns, including callbacks, queues, polling, retries, and failure handling. Previous experience in payments, fintech, or another environment involving highly reliable transactional systems is strongly valued. Experience working with CI/CD pipelines and integrating automated quality checks into software delivery processes. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify risks beyond individual feature requirements. SQL and data-validation skills are an advantage. Experience with distributed systems is a plus. Familiarity with prompt engineering or AI-powered tools for QA and test automation is beneficial. jobgether-jobgether:lever:edcceba2-8ec2-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Sr. UI/UX Designer based in Greece. This is a senior design role focused on creating intuitive, polished, and engaging digital experiences across web and mobile products. You’ll work at the intersection of creative design and technical execution, partnering closely with developers and creative teams. The role offers ownership from early concepts and user flows through high-fidelity designs and interactive prototypes. You’ll bring strong visual design fundamentals while considering usability, responsiveness, accessibility, and how products are actually built. AI-powered design tools will be part of the workflow, helping you explore ideas and prototype quickly without compromising quality. You’ll have the opportunity to work on conventional and experimental digital experiences, with room to contribute creative ideas and new approaches. This is a fully remote position requiring strong communication, autonomy, attention to detail, and availability during AEST working hours. Design intuitive, high-quality user interfaces and experiences for web and mobile products, balancing usability, aesthetics, and technical feasibility. Translate briefs, business objectives, and product requirements into user flows, wireframes, high-fidelity designs, and polished digital experiences. Develop interactive prototypes in Figma that effectively communicate user behaviour, interactions, transitions, and overall product experience. Establish and maintain strong visual design systems, applying disciplined grids, spacing, typography, hierarchy, and responsive layouts. Use AI-powered design and creative tools to accelerate ideation, exploration, and rapid prototyping while maintaining a high standard of design quality. Collaborate closely with developers and technical teams throughout the design process to ensure accurate and practical implementation. Present design concepts and decisions clearly to colleagues, clients, and stakeholders, incorporating feedback while confidently explaining design rationale. Take ownership of projects from initial concept through final delivery, identifying problems and developing thoughtful, creative solutions. Help structure and organise design work, documentation, and workflows so projects progress efficiently across distributed teams. Contribute to experimental and innovative digital experiences, including immersive websites, animations, micro-interactions, and other emerging design approaches where relevant. Requirements: 5+ years of professional experience in UI/UX Design, Product Design, Digital Design, or a comparable senior design position. A strong portfolio demonstrating excellent UI/UX capabilities, visual design quality, and creative range, particularly across web experiences. Advanced proficiency in Figma, including interactive prototyping and the ability to communicate complex interactions effectively. Strong understanding of UI/UX principles, usability, information architecture and hierarchy, responsive design, and accessibility fundamentals. Excellent visual design skills, with a deliberate and consistent approach to grids, spacing, typography, composition, and layout. Proven experience collaborating closely with developers or other technical teams and understanding the practical considerations involved in implementation. Ability to take an idea from an initial concept or rough brief through user flows, design exploration, prototyping, and a polished final experience. Strong creative problem-solving skills, curiosity, and the ability to challenge conventional approaches when appropriate. Excellent written and verbal English, with confidence presenting designs and articulating the reasoning behind design decisions. Ability to work independently, manage priorities, and collaborate effectively within a fully remote environment. Familiarity with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript is a plus,
